strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
So this is the Texas Colony... Looks like nothing but wasteland, though...
Yes. It's a tourist colony modeled on the Earth wilderness of that name.
Going out of your way to build a wilderness inside a colony...
They should've built some places for guys like us to work instead.
I heard this colony was built before the One Year War.
Apparently, its environmental control mirrors were destroyed in the war,
so the desert kept spreading...
But... there's no sign of the Bunker or the Gyandlar...
Don't worry. They must know we've come here...
Knowing them, they won't be able to hold back. They'll show up soon.
We're heading out first! Gotta make those Bunker creeps pay!
Everyone's so fired up...
Captain Bright, shouldn't you stop them...?
Fundamentally, they're just cooperating with us...
Besides, with the enemy possibly lying in wait, we can't drop our guard.
Hmph, true enough. ...I don't like the feel of this.
Dangaioh! Here I come!
Should we head out too? ...Hm!?
Whoa! Here they come, here they come!
...I mean, for guys who supposedly ran here to hide, there's a TON of them!?
Looks like... this was their trap all along...!
Then the attack on Dr. Tarsan was also...
...Yeah, probably. And since Rom Stol and the others haven't come back...
looks like we fell for it hook, line and sinker.
All units, launch! Intercept them!
The Bunker AND the Gyandlar!? Tch, cocky bastards!
Ufufufu... If you insist on fighting, then only death awaits!
That voice... the one from the meteor swarm...!?
Dangaioh... You're Roll Kran, aren't you?
That's right! I'm Roll, Roll Kran!
Bunker, withdraw from this star system at once!
Heh... Ufufu. How brave of you.
Ngh...! So it really is... Flash!?
...It's been a while, Roll Kran.
Burst!?
You didn't seem to recognize us last time...
But you do remember us, don't you!? Roll Kran!
...Roll?
Ugh... uhh...
Roll? What's wrong?
That's... Flash and Burst...
Ufufu... Roll, have you forgotten your old comrades?
You abandoned planet Latesia... and what are you doing now? Fufufu...
Latesia... That means...
Latesia... Isn't that Roll's home world!?
Roll, don't tell me... your memories!?
I was... the leader of the resistance. And Flash and Burst were...
Comrades in that resistance?
And now they're with the Bunker?
So the Bunker's controlling them!?
...No, they...
I see... So this is why you two were sent out ahead of us...
That's right. Any complaints, dear Master Globine?
...None.
Of course. ...Rom Stol's group fell for the diversion, so by now...
N-No way...!
Heh heh heh...
Ufufufu...
I see. Betrayal, schemes... So they'll stoop to anything.
...Roll, what are you going to do?
...If they stand in my way, I'll just have to defeat them...!
Guess we've got no choice!
(But if they set this ambush with people so deeply tied to them...
could there still be one more...?)
Ngh... Even with all my Dark Twin Slayer Sword... I cannot beat them?
Globine, you were not defeated by us...
You were defeated by yourself.
Wh-What!? I... was defeated by myself...!?
Seeking battle, you even came to lend your aid to the Gyandlar...
And drowning in fighting, you lost sight of the swordsman's path.
I... lost sight of... the swordsman's path...?
The martial way exists to strike down evil for the weak, in their place...
In your craving for battle, you threw away everything
you were meant to protect...
Tenku Shinken does not lose to a sword like that.
Had you stayed true to the martial path, I might have been in danger...
...I-I see... Craving battle... I lost my own path... How ironic...
Brother, can't we save him!?
Miss Leina, with wounds like those...
...Ngh... Quite right... I know my own body better than anyone...
Blue Jet... At the end of my life... I got to face a swordsman such as you...
What!?
Hmph, I finish off Rom and his lot, come over here, and you're still at it?
Finished off...!? No way!
Heh heh... They fell to Tenku Chushin Ken's Electro Poison Hand Blade.
Tenku Chushin Ken...!? Him...? And the Poison Hand Blade, you say...!?
What's this Poison Hand Blade?
A style where, after long training, you soak your hands in poison.
A perfected poison hand can deliver lethal venom with a mere scratch,
sending it straight into the opponent, they say...
But he's a mechanical lifeform like Rom, right? What poison could work?
Probably something that rapidly degrades metal or makes it rust,
like some special rust or a Dissolving Fluid...?
And you said Tenku Chushin Ken? Who are you...!?
Hmph, I've no name to give the likes of you...
Rom! You can never beat me!!
Bug! I won't let you sully Tenku Chushin Ken any further!
Hahahaha! Tenku Chushin Ken? Some martial art of justice that is!
You know him?
From the looks of him, he's more like Rom's group than the Gyandlar...
Master Bug... No! Bug Newman... Master Rom and the others' teacher,
Master Kirai... He was his top disciple! Then one day, he just vanished...
To think we'd meet him again in a place like this...!
Bug...!
Heh heh, if it isn't Jet and Drill! You little boys have sure grown up!
We're not little boys anymore!
Bug! Why are you doing this!?
Isn't it obvious!? In the end, only the strong survive in this world!
Bastard! What do you take the sacred Tenku Chushin Ken for!?
I don't take it for anything! The strong win! That's all there is to it!
How awful...
We're not the half-trained kids you used to know,
and in our master's name, we won't forgive you!
Whoever sullies our master Kirai's name gets no mercy, senior or not...
Prepare yourself!
Wait, Blue Jet! I shall be your opponent!
Globine...!
Very well. Today, Tenku Shinken will break your Dark Twin Slayer Sword!
Bring it on!
Heaven, earth, fire, water... and many comrades lend me strength...!
Bug! You could never understand what that means! Here I come!
Shut your mouth! I'll teach you who the strongest really is!
Heh heh heh heh...
What!? Reinforcements? Were they hiding!?
Rom is my prey. Keep your hands off!
Hm... You're the one from back then!
So you remember, Rom Stol. I, Gardy, will be taking your heads!
Another tough-looking one showed up...
Doesn't matter! We'll just beat them all together!
The Gyandlar seem desperate too.
That shows how pressed they are.
Enough to run fully joint operations with the Bunker.
We won't let you have your way!
Heh heh... You've got spirit, if nothing else.
(Gardy... He bothers me. Who... is this man...?)
This is the end!
Flaaash!
Roll...! Help me!
Huh... Flash...?
Roll...?
Hmph, you fool!
Ah, getting away!
Damn it, using dirty tricks...!
Roll, that one's stopped moving!
Finish it, Roll!
Oh no... Burst!
Roll... are you going to kill me...?
...Damn it!
Roll, she's getting away!
Fufufu... So soft, Roll... Next time I'll kill you properly, no agonizing.
Heh heh heh... We meet again... Team Dangaioh,
and the good people of Londo Bell...!
That voice...!? Gil... Is that really you, Gil!?
I've longed to see you... Mia Alice!
Whaaat!? Weren't you dead!?
Seems he survived.
In that explosion!? But...
Heh... That's right,
my body was torn, ripped apart, blown to pieces.
But my soul cried out.
Until I tear you all and that traitor Tarsan limb from limb,
I could not afford to die...!
...What... what a man...
He's insane...
You pitied me and tried to show me mercy.
You defiled my pride as a warrior and laughed at it!
Is that all...?
What...!?
Pride that cheap, you can feed to the dogs.
If you can't even understand human compassion...!
Wow...
...True warriors' hearts resonate with each other through battle!
Someone who can't see why Roll and the others tried to save your life
has no warrior's pride at all!
That's right! You only died because you wouldn't just surrender,
so this grudge of yours is totally misplaced!
However you all howl, I don't care!
Dangaioh... No, Mia Alice! Until I strangle you with these hands...
I'll hunt you down by any means necessary!
Gil Berg! So you're the one who turned Flash and Burst...!
Wait, what? What's that supposed to mean!?
So you're the one who corrupted Roll's old friends!?
Corrupted...? Heh heh heh... They chose to join the Bunker.
Just like me.
Gil... why go so far...!?
Gil Berg, you...
Well, well, Shazara... I'll show you how traitors end up.
I'll have vengeance for my planet, Lilith...!
...We settle this here... Gil Berg.
Interesting... Go ahead and try!
My, my, can't you leave this to us?
No need to rush. We could've slaughtered them all by ourselves...
Let's go! Everyone!
A trap this elaborate... If we break through, we'll deal them a major blow!
Everyone, stay sharp!
Blue Jet! Now your Tenku Shinken and my Dark Twin Slayer Sword...
shall settle things once and for all!
Wait, Globine! I ask you once more! For what do you wield that sword!?
Enough!
I told you, fighting is a swordsman's work. Battle is my reason for living!
No, you're wrong, Globine...! If you're a true swordsman, you should know...
The martial way means striking down evil on behalf of the weak!
Wh-What...
If you just want to fight, you're no better than some brawling thug!
Ask your sword!
However you deceive your heart, you can't disguise your sword's spirit!
...I can hear your sword weeping...!
Heh... Nicely put.
...But a martial artist's technique can't be fooled.
What answer will he reach...? This should be worth seeing.
Hmmm... My sword... is weeping, you say...
Yes. If you're someone Jet thinks so highly of...
you must already realize it!
Was he being fooled by the Gyandlar too!?
No. ...How do I put it... More like he was fooling himself...
Heh... Heh heh... Hahahaha! Blue Jet, well said!
Indeed... Perhaps I was merely afraid of becoming unneeded...
nothing more than a coward...
Globine...
Planet Kronos... How many years have passed since I was driven
from my hometown...
...I lived for nothing but battle. Yet my heart never found peace...
No wonder, for I had been deceiving my own sword... Fwahahaha!
I thank you, Blue Jet.
The doubt in my heart has cleared, without a single cloud!
Globine...
My eyes have been opened.
As you said, from now on, my Dark Twin Slayer Sword
shall be wielded to strike down evil...!
Isn't that wonderful, Brother?
Yes. Between true martial artists... hearts always connect.
A fighter speaks with his fists, a swordsman with his blade... is that it?
Master... then you and I...
Damn you... Globine, I trust you're prepared for this!
Acquired skill "Comeback".
...The swordsman Globine and his Dark Twin Slayer Sword... I won't forget.
Globine... Even in defeat, he was a true swordsman...
Hmph, looks like you've trained enough to back up that big mouth.
Bug!
Today was just a warm-up. Rom, the next time we meet is the day you die!
A softie like you isn't fit to inherit Tenku Chushin Ken...!
Never forget that I'm the one worthy of inheriting it!
Wait! You don't grasp the essence of Tenku Chushin Ken, or its meaning...!
Then try and beat me! I'll be looking forward to it, little Rom,
Hahahahaha...!
What's wrong, Gardy!? Is that all you've got!?
Ngh... Not bad, Tenku Chushin Ken...
This ends now!
No choice. Diondra's group should've had time to reach the surface...
Rom Stol, we'll settle this another time!
Ah, wait!
Stop it, Jim. We can't catch him now...
Tch, that guy sure knows how to run...
Gardy... He seems a little different from the other Gyandlar...
Jet, did you hear that?
Yes... It wasn't just an ambush. Seems we were thoroughly duped...
Nngh, you're as good as ever. ...However!
He's running!?
After all that big talk, you're turning tail!?
Heh heh... Don't be hasty. I still need to get used to this body...!
Gil!
Heh heh... In the end, I gained a place in the Bunker and a stronger body.
...All that's left is to kill you!
This guy's rotten to the core!
Heh heh... Hahahahahaha!
Gil... Berg...
That man... scares me. Brother...
...Drowning in power, he's lost himself.
One stained by desire, blind to the truth... must be cut down, eh?
It's over... huh.
This sucks. ...Those damn Bunker and Gyandlar creeps.
Still, they've probably learned their lesson, right?
But no matter how many grunts we knock down...
Unless we crush the snake's head, we'll stay on the back foot forever.
And we can't keep fighting like that forever...
The Bunker... We must strike before their main force reaches Earth.
Come to think of it, they were searching for something.
They mentioned Mutron before, right?
On that subject, there's also the Gyandlar to consider.
Honestly... what a headache.
We just crush them one by one... until we hit the head.
That Gyandlar leader-type guy said something, didn't he?
It's kinda been bugging me.
Captain Bright, if what Gardy said is true...
then a separate Gyandlar unit has descended to Earth.
That information is true, I assure you.
So it seems. ...Will you pursue them, Rom?
Yes. We can't let them keep scheming in the shadows.
I'm worried about Commander Hazuki and the others on the surface too.
We'll be sure to stop by and say hi, so don't worry!
It's a shame to lose Rom and the others...
but we can't just leave the Gyandlar alone...
I'm sorry for being so selfish...
Not at all. You've been helping us of your own will from the start.
Take whatever action you judge you must.
That's Captain Bright for ya. You really get it.
You lot have trained me well.
That's quite a way of putting it.
Ahaha, Judau! He complimented you!
But... in this vast universe... why do so many invaders gather at Earth?
I just wish they'd leave us alone...
It's not like every last one of them is drawn by Earth's gravity.
(Drawn by Earth's gravity... Them too?)
